mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP growth) signals robust demand growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in monthly PAYEMS (employment) indicates strengthening labor markets, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained employment growth, or if inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and UNRATE (unemployment) above 3.5% and 4% respectively over 3 months signals conflicting policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the policy conflict, or if other macro factors override the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (tightening) indicate aggressive monetary policy and cost-push inflation, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the inflation-tightening combo, or if GDP growth (GDPC1) offsets the inflationary pressure.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (employment) alongside falling UNRATE (unemployment) reflects a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the labor market strength, or if high inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) coinciding with falling FEDFUNDS rates signals economic expansion and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the GDP-Fed combination, or if supply-side factors (e.g., INDPRO) weaken simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in RSAFS (industrial production) below 50 for 2 months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: regime:late-cycle expansion AND RSAFS < 50 for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the late-cycle signal, or if GDP growth (GDPC1) remains robust concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO (supply) alongside rising FEDFUNDS (tightening) indicates supply-side growth offset by restrictive policy, leading to muted S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the supply-tightening combo, or if demand indicators (GDPC1) surge concurrently.
